description:
Who doesn't love the McDonald's Shamrock Shake and now the McFlurry....

These are so easy to make and as they are the same ice cream, you might as well make both at the same time!

A super simple recipe using the below:

500ml Double (Heavy) Cream
250ml Milk
150g cup sugar
2-3 Tbsp Fat Free (1%) Milk Powder
2 Tbsp Vanilla Extract
1/16 Tsp Peppermint Extract
Green Food Colouring to suit

You can leave the milkshake ice cream in the freezer until ready to use but as I mention in the video....ADD MORE COLOUR AND TASTE as you lose some when mixing with the milk.
